meta.title: Research themes
meta.description: REPM + India Government Schemes & Policy Tailwinds (2026) — About-friendly keywords; scheme names in theme_research_patterns.json
meta.syntax: + means AND, | means OR (AND binds tighter inside a clause)

themes.name: Rare Earth Permanent Magnets (REPM) & Motor Assemblies
themes.display_pattern: hard ferrites | soft ferrites | ferrites | flywheel magneto | traction motors | traction + motor | BLDC motors | integrated motor | IGBT propulsion | heavy mineral sand | monazite | magnet winding wires | electronic ignition | e-mobility + motor | rare earth

keyword_definitions.REPM: Rare Earth Permanent Magnet — NdFeB/SmCo magnets for EV traction motors, wind generators, and defense guidance systems.
keyword_definitions.NdFeB: Neodymium-Iron-Boron; strongest commercial permanent magnet alloy (often absent from Screener About — use ferrites/traction motor proxies).
keyword_definitions.SmCo: Samarium-Cobalt; high-temperature rare earth magnet for aerospace and defense motors.
keyword_definitions.hard ferrites: Sintered ferrite magnets used in automotive magnetos, alternators, and small motors (Delta Manufacturing).
keyword_definitions.flywheel magneto: Magneto-based ignition assembly — stator/rotor magnet stack (India Nippon).
keyword_definitions.traction motors: EV/rail propulsion motor — primary downstream demand driver for REPM (Sona Comstar, Varroc, Hirect).
keyword_definitions.BLDC motors: Brushless DC motors using permanent-magnet rotors (Ram Ratna Wires).
keyword_definitions.heavy mineral sand: Beach-sand feedstock for monazite/rutile — upstream rare earth corridor (Midwest, NMDC).
keyword_definitions.monazite: Mineral sand containing rare earth phosphates; IREL/NLC processing chain feedstock.
keyword_definitions.magnet winding wires: Enamelled copper for motor windings — adjacent to magnet/motor supply chain.
keyword_definitions.REPM scheme: ₹7,280 crore PLI to build ~6,000 MTPA domestic REPM capacity (news/research terms).

themes.name: Electronics Components, SPECS & ISM 2.0
themes.display_pattern: EMS | electronics manufacturing services | ESDM | printed circuit | PCB | PCB assembly | electronic components | OSAT | semiconductor packaging | chip design | electronics manufacturing | contract manufacturing + electronics | sensor + manufacturing | LED + manufacturing

keyword_definitions.Electronics Component Manufacturing Sche: ₹40,000 crore outlay to localize the $40B electronics component import bill (PCBs, displays, sensors).
keyword_definitions.SPECS scheme: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors; provides 25% capex subsidy.
keyword_definitions.SPECS: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors; provides 25% capex subsidy.
keyword_definitions.component import substitution: Policy goal of replacing imported sub-assemblies with domestic value addition (DVA).
keyword_definitions.ISM 2.0: India Semiconductor Mission 2.0; ₹1.25 lakh crore commitment for fab, ATMP, and indigenous chip design.
keyword_definitions.EMS: Electronics Manufacturing Services — contract design/build of PCBs and box-builds (Kaynes, Syrma, Dixon).
keyword_definitions.ESDM: Electronics System Design & Manufacturing — India policy umbrella for local electronics value chain.
keyword_definitions.OSAT: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test — chip packaging/test plants targeted under ISM.
keyword_definitions.ATMP: Assembly, Testing, Marking and Packaging — semiconductor backend operations.
keyword_definitions.electronic components: PCBs, connectors, passives, displays, sensors — SPECS localization focus.
keyword_definitions.PCB assembly: PCBA / SMT line assembly for EMS and ODMs.

themes.name: India AI Mission & Data Centre Tax Holiday (2047)
themes.display_pattern: data centre | data center | colocation | hyperscale | cloud infrastructure | cloud + data centre | cloud + data center | GPU + server | AI compute | power + data centre | power + data center

keyword_definitions.India AI Mission: ₹10,372 crore allocation for domestic AI compute infrastructure, startup grants, and sovereign LLM development.
keyword_definitions.data centre tax holiday: Income tax exemptions extended until 2047 for global cloud providers setting up Indian data centers.
keyword_definitions.sovereign AI: Government-backed initiative to build indigenous large language models and secure domestic AI compute stacks.
keyword_definitions.data centre: Hyperscale / colo / enterprise data center capacity (power + land + cooling).
keyword_definitions.cloud infrastructure: Cloud / colo build-out — racks, networking, and facility power.
keyword_definitions.AI compute: GPU/accelerator clusters for training and inference — India AI Mission demand driver.
keyword_definitions.colocation: Wholesale / retail colo facilities hosting third-party IT load.
keyword_definitions.hyperscale: Large-campus data centers for cloud / AI tenants.

themes.name: EV Fleets, Charging Infra & Green Mobility
themes.display_pattern: electric vehicle | electric bus | e-bus | e-mobility | EV charging | charging infrastructure | charging station | battery pack | lithium-ion | battery swapping | green mobility | zero emission | two wheeler + electric | three wheeler + electric | EV + component

keyword_definitions.electric ambulance: ₹500 crore allocation to modernize emergency response fleets with EVs.
keyword_definitions.EV infrastructure fund: ₹2,000 crore outlay for highway charging networks, battery swapping grids, and depot charging.
keyword_definitions.EV fleet + electrification: Policy push targeting commercial fleets (buses, ambulances, logistics) rather than just passenger cars.
keyword_definitions.FAME III: Expected successor to FAME II, focusing on commercial EV fleets and localized battery cell manufacturing.
keyword_definitions.FAME: Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Electric Vehicles — demand/supply incentives for EVs.
keyword_definitions.e-mobility: Electric mobility stack — vehicles, motors, batteries, and charging.
keyword_definitions.charging station: Public / depot EV chargers — infra fund demand driver.

themes.name: Regional Medical Hubs & Senior Citizen Healthcare
themes.display_pattern: multispecialty hospital | multi-specialty hospital | tertiary care | quaternary care | medical tourism | hospital + chain | super specialty | critical care + hospital | regional medical hub | Ayushman Bharat | PM-JAY | senior citizen + health | health wellness center

keyword_definitions.regional medical hub: 5 mega-hospitals built in PPP mode to decentralize quaternary care and reduce medical tourism leakage.
keyword_definitions.PM-JAY + 70+: Extension of ₹5 lakh annual health cover to all senior citizens (70+), massively expanding the insured patient pool for private hospitals.
keyword_definitions.Ayushman Bharat: National health protection / wellness-centre umbrella that expands insured inpatient volumes.
keyword_definitions.multispecialty hospital: Private hospital chains offering multi-specialty tertiary/quaternary care — primary PM-JAY capacity.
keyword_definitions.medical tourism: Inbound elective care — policy push to keep volumes in Indian hubs.

themes.name: MSME Credit, SME Growth Fund & Risk Capital
themes.display_pattern: MSME | microfinance | small + medium + enterprise | SME lending | MSME + credit | credit guarantee | CGTMSE | TReDS | Udyam | SME Growth Fund | Self-Reliant India Fund | risk capital + micro | priority sector + MSME

keyword_definitions.SME Growth Fund: ₹10,000 crore corpus to provide equity and subordinate debt to job-creating MSMEs.
keyword_definitions.Self-Reliant India Fund: ₹2,000 crore top-up specifically for micro-enterprise risk capital and grassroots entrepreneurship.
keyword_definitions.CGTMSE: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises; the backbone of collateral-free MSME lending in India.
keyword_definitions.MSME: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises — formalization and credit push via Udyam / CGTMSE / TReDS.
keyword_definitions.microfinance: Unsecured micro-loans to micro-enterprises and households — listed NBFC-MFIs and SFBs.
keyword_definitions.TReDS: Trade Receivables Discounting System — invoice discounting platform for MSME cash-flow.

themes.name: PM Surya Ghar & Residential Rooftop Solar
themes.display_pattern: rooftop solar | solar rooftop | rooftop + solar | residential solar | solar EPC | photovoltaic | solar module | solar + module | solar + inverter | net metering | distributed solar | rooftop + EPC

keyword_definitions.PM Surya Ghar: Flagship scheme providing up to ₹78,000 subsidy per household for rooftop solar, targeting 1 crore homes.
keyword_definitions.1 crore homes + solar: Explicit volume target of PM Surya Ghar — drives residential EPC order books.
keyword_definitions.decentralized renewable: Shift from utility-scale solar parks to distributed, behind-the-meter residential and commercial solar.
keyword_definitions.rooftop solar: Behind-the-meter PV on homes/SMEs — core PM Surya Ghar demand.
keyword_definitions.solar module: Crystalline / thin-film PV modules and cells — domestic manufacturing under ALMM/PLI.
keyword_definitions.solar EPC: Engineering, procurement and construction for rooftop and distributed solar.
keyword_definitions.net metering: Grid-export credit policy that improves rooftop solar payback.

themes.name: PLI for Food Processing & Aseptic Packaging

keyword_definitions.PLI + food processing: Production Linked Incentive for food processing — supports aseptic packaging, sprays, and value-added exports.
keyword_definitions.MoFPI + incentive: Ministry of Food Processing Industries grants validating capex in aseptic lines and spray-dried powders.
keyword_definitions.aseptic + PLI: Subsidies targeting shelf-stable packaging formats (e.g. Tetra Recart) vs traditional canning.
keyword_definitions.food processing: Value-added processing of agri produce — core MoFPI / PLI beneficiary set.
keyword_definitions.aseptic: Aseptic filling / packaging for pulp, puree, dairy — PLI-favoured format.
keyword_definitions.ready to eat: RTE / convenience foods — packaged foods exporters and domestic brands.
keyword_definitions.fruit pulp: Fruit pulp / concentrate for exports and beverage blenders.
keyword_definitions.cold storage: Cold storage / controlled atmosphere — food value-chain infrastructure.
keyword_definitions.edible oil: Edible oil refining / packing — large listed processors.

themes.display_pattern: food processing | processed food | ready to eat | ready-to-eat | frozen food | fruit pulp | mango pulp | aseptic | aseptic + packaging | spray dried | spray-dried | packaged food | milk powder | dairy processing | edible oil | rice mill | flour mill | spice processing | snack food | cold storage | export + food | fruit + processing | vegetable + processing

themes.name: National Fibre Scheme & Textile Modernization
themes.display_pattern: man made fibre | man-made fibre | polyester yarn | viscose | technical textiles | home textiles | home textile | spun yarn | woven fabric | apparel export | Mega Textile Park | MITRA park | National Fibre Scheme | jute | PLI + textile | PLI + textiles

keyword_definitions.National Fibre Scheme: Umbrella scheme integrating natural (jute, silk, wool) and man-made fibers (MMF) to achieve self-reliance.
keyword_definitions.man-made fibre: MMF (polyester, viscose); the high-growth segment of global textiles where India is aggressively trying to capture Bangladesh/Vietnam market share.
keyword_definitions.MITRA park: Mega Investment Textiles and Apparel parks; integrated plug-and-play infrastructure for global apparel brands.
keyword_definitions.technical textiles: Non-apparel industrial textiles (auto, geotextile, medical) — PLI priority segment.
keyword_definitions.home textiles: Bed/bath/kitchen textiles — large listed exporters (Welspun, Indo Count, Trident).

themes.name: National Logistics Policy, Gati Shakti & IMEEC
themes.display_pattern: multimodal logistics | logistics park | multimodal logistics park | freight corridor | container freight | rail + freight | third party logistics | 3PL | cold chain | warehousing + logistics | coastal shipping | multimodal | container + terminal | ICD + logistics | freight + forwarding

keyword_definitions.IMEEC: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor — rail/shipping corridor to accelerate export logistics.
keyword_definitions.Gati Shakti: National Master Plan for multi-modal connectivity across infrastructure ministries.
keyword_definitions.National Logistics Policy: Framework to cut logistics cost toward ~8% of GDP via ULIP, MMLPs, and multimodal corridors.
keyword_definitions.ULIP: Unified Logistics Interface Platform — digital API backbone of NLP.
keyword_definitions.multimodal logistics park: MMLPs combining rail, road, and warehousing.
keyword_definitions.3PL: Third-party logistics providers — warehousing, freight, last-mile.
keyword_definitions.cold chain: Temperature-controlled logistics for food/pharma — NLP priority.

themes.name: Social Security, Pensions & Financial Inclusion
themes.display_pattern: life insurance | health insurance | general insurance | microinsurance | pension | annuity | Atal Pension Yojana | Atal Pension | APY | PMJJBY | PMSBY | financial inclusion | insurance premium | pension AUM | direct benefit transfer

keyword_definitions.Atal Pension Yojana: APY; guaranteed old-age income security scheme targeting the massive unorganized sector workforce.
keyword_definitions.PMJJBY: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana; government-backed micro-life insurance driving massive premium volume for private insurers.
keyword_definitions.financial inclusion + JAM: Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile trinity; the digital rail enabling direct benefit transfers and mass-market financialization.
keyword_definitions.PMSBY: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana — government accident micro-insurance.
keyword_definitions.life insurance: Life / ULIP / annuity books that distribute APY and PMJJBY-style products at scale.
